title: Enterprise Indirect Tax (VAT/GST/Sales & Use Tax), Constrained STC Classifier, AP Use-Tax & Peppol e-Invoicing Agent

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Static ERP Tax Rate Tables + Manual Exemption Certificate Binders + Monthly Batch Filing
tiers.architecture: Hardcoded ERP ZIP-code tax tables + unvalidated PDF resale certificates + manual spreadsheet VAT/Use-Tax accruals

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Prompt-Only General LLM Tax Rate & Statute Chatbot
tiers.architecture: Asking a general LLM to calculate multi-jurisdiction sales/VAT tax rates and classify SaaS/hardware bundle taxability from free text

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Tax Engine API + Manual SKU Mapping (No Automated STC Classifier or AP Use-Tax Accrual)
tiers.architecture: Avalara/Vertex checkout API with default catch-all SKU mapping (`TPP00000`) and manual AP vendor invoice tax review

tiers.tier: Tier 4: Constrained STC Taxonomy Classifier + Rooftop-Geo Tax Engine + AP Use-Tax AST + Peppol UBL Gate Agent
tiers.architecture: Constrained Taxability Code (STC) Classifier + Rooftop Geo-Polygon Tax Engine + AP Consumer Use-Tax Self-Accrual AST + VIES/Exemption VLM + Peppol BIS 3.0 UBL Gate

scenarios.scenario: SaaS + Cloud Inference Token + Edge Hardware Bundle Taxability (`STC` Classification Across 45 US States & EU VAT)
scenarios.question: Classify a new enterprise SKU bundling 'Cloud AI Copilot SaaS + 10M API Tokens + Pre-Configured Edge Appliance' across Texas (80% SaaS taxable), New York (100% SaaS taxable), California (SaaS exempt, hardware taxable), and EU B2B Reverse-Charge VAT
scenarios.model_answer: Constrained STC ontology classifier unbundles SKU into `DC010500 (SaaS)` + `TPP040200 (Edge Hardware)` + `Usage_API`; deterministic Vertex/Avalara engine applies exact state unbundling rules and EU Art. 196 Reverse-Charge (0.0% audit assessment error)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 3 maps the entire bundle to catch-all Tangible Personal Property (`TPP`), overcharging California customers 8.75% on SaaS while Tier 2 LLM hallucinates state tax rates (16.8% error).

scenarios.scenario: Accounts Payable (AP) Vendor Invoice Consumer Use-Tax Self-Accrual & Manufacturing Exemption Clawback
scenarios.question: Audit 35,000 monthly AP vendor invoices where an out-of-state supplier billed $240,000 for cloud servers shipped to an Ohio R&D lab with $0.00 sales tax, while another vendor charged $18,500 tax on exempt cleanroom production machinery
scenarios.model_answer: AP Use-Tax AST cross-checks cost-center usage against state industrial/R&D exemptions -> auto-accrues $13,800 Ohio Consumer Use Tax on the untaxed lab servers (preventing audit penalties) and flags $18,500 vendor tax overcharge for refund (0.2% variance)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 AP clerks pay vendor invoices as-billed, incurring 12.6% combined audit underpayment penalties and missed manufacturing tax exemptions.

scenarios.scenario: B2B Resale / Exemption Certificate (`MTC / SST / EU VIES`) VLM Extraction & Real-Time Checkout Gate
scenarios.question: Wholesale buyer uploads a scanned Multi-State Uniform Sales & Use Tax Exemption Certificate at checkout for a $95,000 order shipping to Florida and Illinois
scenarios.model_answer: Document VLM extracts state registration numbers, expiration dates, and buyer signature; gateway verifies live state DOR / EU VIES API status before granting tax-exempt checkout (0.0% invalid certificate escape)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 accepts an expired or unsigned PDF certificate in a shared folder, leaving the seller liable for $6,650 in uncollected tax plus 25% audit penalty (19.5% escape).

scenarios.scenario: Real-Time Continuous Transaction Controls (`CTC / Peppol BIS 3.0 / EU ViDA`) e-Invoice XML Clearance Gate
scenarios.question: Transmit 180,000 monthly cross-border B2B invoices across Italy (`SDI`), Poland (`KSeF`), Germany (`XRechnung`), and Singapore (`InvoiceNow Peppol`) without government clearance rejections
scenarios.model_answer: Compile ERP invoice into `UBL 2.1 / CII XML` and validate against deterministic `Schematron / EN 16931` syntax + VAT-calculation rounding rules before transmitting to government CTC portal (0.0% clearance rejection)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 & Tier 2 suffer 14.2%–22.0% government portal rejections due to line-level vs. header-level VAT rounding discrepancies and missing Buyer Reference (`BT-10`) tags, freezing accounts receivable.

perturbation_checks.check: ZIP-Code Boundary Split (Two Street Addresses in Same 5-Digit ZIP Fall in Different Special Tax Districts)
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 0.0% Error (Rooftop Lat/Long Geo-Polygon Boundary Lookup Rather Than 5-Digit ZIP Table)

perturbation_checks.check: Wayfair Economic Nexus Threshold Crossing ($100,000 Sales or 200 Transactions Rolling 12-Month Window)
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 0.0% Escape (80% Watermark Alert Triggers State Registration Before Threshold Breach)

key_findings: Tier 4 (Constrained STC Taxonomy Classifier + Rooftop Geo-Polygon Tax Engine + AP Consumer Use-Tax AST + VIES/Exemption VLM + EN 16931 Peppol Gate) eliminates sales/VAT audit assessment errors (0.0%) and government e-invoice clearance rejections (0.0%).

Separating LLM semantic product-to-STC taxonomy mapping from deterministic rooftop tax-rate calculation prevents the 16.8% tax-rate hallucination of Prompt-Only LLMs and the 3.1% catch-all SKU mapping error of unconfigured tax engines.

Auditing 100% of AP vendor invoices for Consumer Use-Tax self-accrual vs. R&D/manufacturing exemptions and validating exemption certificates via live DOR/VIES APIs cuts monthly tax penalty, overpayment, and compliance TCO from $780K to $64K (-91.8%).
